speech_verification.heard: Two days after staff measured a growing bend, the Quebec Bridge collapsed. On August 27, Cord 9L's bend had grown. Some workers called it critical, but the superintendent disagreed. On August 29, the massive steel structure fell. A royal commission found the failed lower cords were defectively designed. It did not believe the bridge could be saved after August 27. Better judgment the commission found might have prevented the loss of life.
